components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Compact utility button used in prompt headers to copy exact prompt text.
components.css: .ds-copy-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.125rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-copy-button:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--bg-subtle); } .ds-copy-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-copy-button.is-copied { border-color: var(--done-line); background: var(--done-soft); color: var(--done); } .ds-copy-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Prompt Panel
components.description: Copy-ready prompt block with a neutral header and monospace body.
components.css: .ds-prompt { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--ink); } .ds-prompt-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-inset); } .ds-prompt-title { font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-prompt-meta { color: var(--ink-3); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-copy-button { margin-left: auto; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-copy-button:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3); background: var(--bg-subtle); } .ds-copy-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-prompt-body { margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.125rem 1.125rem; color: var(--ink); font: 400 0.875rem/1.6 var(--font-mono); white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; tab-size: 2; }

components.name: Checkpoint Card
components.description: Tickable progress card saved in browser localStorage.
components.css: .ds-checkpoint { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.875rem; align-items: start; padding: 1rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.35s var(--ease-out); } .ds-checkpoint:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-checkpoint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-check-box { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink-3); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg); } .ds-check-box svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 2.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-checkpoint.is-done { border-color: var(--done-line); background: var(--done-soft); } .ds-checkpoint.is-done .ds-check-box { border-color: var(--done); background: var(--done); } .ds-checkpoint.is-done .ds-check-box svg { stroke: var(--on-done); }

components.name: Note Callout
components.html: This guide is for the standalone GitHub Copilot desktop app.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.75rem; align-items: start; padding: 0.875rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent-line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans); } .ds-callout p { margin: 0; } .ds-callout-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; margin-top: 0.1875rem; color: var(--accent); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Warning Callout
components.description: Instructional caution block for consequential workshop warnings.
components.html: Do not approve a full implementation just to save the plan.
components.css: .ds-callout-warning { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.75rem; align-items: start; padding: 0.875rem 1.125rem; border: 1px solid var(--warn-line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-sans); } .ds-callout-warning p { margin: 0; } .ds-callout-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; margin-top: 0.1875rem; color: var(--warn-icon); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Step Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar row that shows step number, title, time, active location, and done state.
components.html: 1Meet the app and start a project10 min
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; column-gap: 0.625rem; align-items: start; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--ink-2); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--bg-inset); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-marker { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; margin-top: -0.0625rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink-2); font: 600 0.75rem/1 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nav-link.is-active .ds-nav-marker { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-time { padding-top: 0.125rem; color: var(--ink-3); font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: At-a-glance Panel
components.description: Four-item facts panel at the top of the guide.
components.html:
Audience
People with little or no software-development experience.
Time
About 90–120 minutes.
components.css: .ds-glance { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); } .ds-glance-item { padding: 1rem 1.125rem 1.0625rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-glance-item:nth-child(-n + 2) { border-top: 0; } .ds-glance-item:nth-child(even) { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-glance dt { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; color: var(--ink-3); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-glance dd { margin: 0; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.5 var(--font-sans); } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .ds-glance { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .ds-glance-item:nth-child(even) { border-left: 0; } .ds-glance-item:nth-child(2) { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } }

components.name: Workflow Chips
components.description: Compact sequence chips for the workshop workflow.
components.css: .ds-workflow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 0.375rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; color: var(--ink); } .ds-workflow li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-workflow span { padding: 0.3125rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--bg); font: 600 0.9375rem/1.35 var(--font-sans); } .ds-workflow svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--ink-3); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

narrative.overview:
This system is a calm documentation room for a live beginner workshop. It behaves like a trusted reference page beside the GitHub Copilot app: one readable column, a persistent step list, copy-ready prompt blocks, and checkpoints that visibly remember progress. The owner deliberately chose the category-standard documentation look over a themed direction, with Stripe Docs, GOV.UK step-by-step guidance, and MDN as the quality bar.

The visual world is intentionally plain: white page, near-black ink, blue links, green completion, amber cautions and placeholders, system fonts, 1px hairlines, and 12px container corners. It refuses adventure metaphors, quest styling, decorative shadows, and marketing gloss. Light mode is the default use scene for a daytime workshop room; dark mode follows the operating system using the same semantic tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Single-column reading measure with a sticky progress sidebar on wide screens.
Semantic color discipline: blue means navigation/action, green means done, amber means caution or replace-this placeholder.
Flat surfaces with 1px borders and tonal background shifts instead of decorative depth.
System sans everywhere except prompts and code, which use a monospace stack.
Copy and checkpoint interactions are progressive enhancement, never required to understand the guide.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the single navigation and action accent; do not introduce additional accent colors for ordinary emphasis.

rules.name: The Green Means Done Rule
rules.body: Green appears only when something is complete, copied, or checked off.

rules.name: The Amber Is Instructional Rule
rules.body: Amber is for placeholders and cautions; it must tell the learner to pay attention or replace something.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not add web fonts; the page makes no external font requests by design.

rules.name: The Monospace Means Exact Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for prompts, code, file paths, and values the learner may copy.

rules.name: The One Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading content, sources, and footer share the same 42rem measure; do not widen prose to fill the viewport.

rules.name: The Sidebar Is Progress Rule
rules.body: The left rail exists to show steps, time, active position, and checkpoint progress, not secondary marketing or decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Canon Rule
rules.body: Do not add drop shadows, glows, or layered cards; a 1px hairline and subtle background shift are the depth language.

dos: Do preserve the category-standard documentation page: sticky step list, one readable column, copyable prompts, and visible checkpoints.
Do keep colors semantic: blue for links/actions, green for completion, amber for cautions and placeholders.
Do use the system font stacks so the GitHub Pages site makes no external font requests.
Do keep borders at 1px unless the control needs stronger checkbox legibility.
Do expand or stack complex content at narrow widths instead of allowing horizontal page scroll, except inside table wrappers where horizontal overflow is intentional.
donts: Don't introduce adventure, quest, trail, expedition, map, badge, or game styling.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, glassmorphism, hero art, marketing gloss, or animated flourish.
Don't use green for anything that is not complete or copied.
Don't use amber as brand color; it is only for cautions and placeholders.
Don't add external fonts, icon packages, analytics, or third-party visual dependencies.
